advisory.finding: test_the_guard_runs_before_any_client_is_built does not prove the invariant it claims. It patches `dc_transport._jira_client_class` as a must-not-be-called sentinel, but `resolve_jira_datacenter_settings` never calls into transport.py — client construction happens in `build_client_from_settings` (invoked by backend.py, not by the function under test). The sentinel is therefore unreachable from the code path exercised, so the test would still pass if the ordering it asserts were violated.
merged_from: test_the_guard_runs_before_any_client_is_built monkeypatches dc_transport._jira_client_class to fail if invoked, but only calls resolve_jira_datacenter_settings(), which never reaches the transport/client-construction path (client is built by the separate build_client_from_settings() in backend.py:184-185). The 'no client is constructed' guard is therefore inert — it would never fire even in the buggy pre-fix world — so the test cannot detect a regression that moves the guard too late (e.g. into build_client_from_settings). Its only live assertion (pytest.raises + 'JIRA_PAT' in message) duplicates the parametrized 'unset' case, leaving the ticket's 'fails BEFORE any client construction' acceptance criterion effectively untested.
